title: MEMLNaut MIDI Device Template Schema
description: Describes one external MIDI synth/device as a template of named, CC-addressable parameters. Used by NISPS to let a performer pick a device, see its parameters by name, and select which ones the ML drives via MIDI CC. Codegen (codegen/generate-midi-devices.ts) consumes these to emit a no-heap C++ header (nisps/midi/generated/midi_devices.hpp) and a typed TS module (manifold/src/midi-devices/generated/). Provenance + sources for the CC numbers live in synth-midi-cc.json.

device_id.description: snake_case unique identifier for the device.

name.description: Human-readable device name shown in the picker.

value_range.description: [min, max] CC value range; almost always [0, 127].

notes.description: How to enable CC on this device, channel quirks, etc.

id.description: snake_case unique-within-device identifier, derived from the label.

label.description: Human-readable parameter name shown in the UI.

default.description: Value sent when the param is fixed (not ML-driven).

group.description: Coarse section for UI grouping (osc, filter, env, lfo, mod, fx, arp, mix, global).
